user.title: Lights Simulator
user.description: Randomly turns your lights on and off while the house is empty. Time windows, rhythm, light sensors and backups are set afterwards in the « Lights Simulator » panel.

data.importer: Import my current settings (« Simulateur présence » helpers)

data_description.alarme: Used when the alarm triggers the simulation.
data_description.personnes: Used when presence triggers the simulation: the house is empty when everyone is away.
data_description.importer: Imports windows, days, rhythm, weights and mode. Existing helpers are neither changed nor removed.

init.description:
**[Open Lights Simulator settings](/lights-simulator)**

Simulator settings are made in this panel. When hidden from the sidebar, it stays reachable through this link, the Lights Simulator device's "Visit" link, the Lovelace card ("Ouvrir les réglages" button) or at /lights-simulator.
